description: Research candidate; no single-equation catalogue field is closed by these results.

affine_converse.scope: Operations A*x+B*y+d on arbitrary commutative rings, finite or infinite, including rings with nilpotents.

additive_extension_checks.method: For each admissible nonzero pair of scalar coefficients, impose bridge independence and the normalized candidate by linear equations on the offset table; check that the whole solution space satisfies both image-basis identities.

rejected_short_candidate.failure: U(0)=1, whereas the image basis requires U(0)=0.
rejected_short_candidate.note: This refutes only the shorter G(y,U(x))=x identity, not the 782-operation candidate.

unproved_argument_warning: The tentative order-28/order-19 argument requires U to commute with every row. This extra identity has not been proved and must not be assumed.

prime_order_converse.status: proved in Lean for all prime carrier cardinalities; composite orders remain open
prime_order_converse.proof: A full cycle of a makes the commuting maps b,c translations in cyclic coordinates. Row conjugacy and simultaneous shifts force D(x,y)=-gamma^3*x+gamma*y+d, so the existing affine converse forces a=id. Equal cycle lengths then give the general prime-cardinality result.
prime_order_converse.catalogue_note: No unrestricted SingleEquation row closes. This theorem concerns the 782-operation sandwich candidate, not the F^2 G^4 U candidate.
